headword: {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}

definitions.gloss: performance technique; playing technique; musical skill
definitions.explanation: The technical skill and proficiency involved in playing a musical instrument or performing music. Encompasses both fundamental mechanics and advanced expressive techniques.

examples.japanese: この{演奏者|えんそうしゃ}は{演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This performer has a high level of playing technique.

examples.japanese: {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}だけでなく{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}も{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Not only performance technique but also expressive ability is important.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}の{練習|れんしゅう}を{続|つづ}けることで、{演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}は{確実|かくじつ}に{向上|こうじょう}する。
examples.english: By continuing to practice every day, your performance technique will steadily improve.

notes:
Composed of {演奏|えんそう} (musical performance) and {技術|ぎじゅつ} (technique, skill). Used in music education, reviews, and competitions to evaluate or discuss a performer's technical abilities. In Japanese music criticism, there is a traditional distinction between {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ} (technical proficiency) and {音楽性|おんがくせい} (musicality), with the ideal being a balance of both.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}を{磨|みが}く: to polish one's playing technique
- {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}が{優|すぐ}れている: to have excellent technique
- {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}の{向上|こうじょう}: improvement of performance skill
- {高度|こうど}な{演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}: advanced performance technique

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {演奏|えんそう}: musical performance — the act itself, not the skill level
- {技巧|ぎこう}: virtuosity, artistry — emphasizes the artistic or virtuosic aspect of technique
- {奏法|そうほう}: playing method — focuses on the specific way an instrument is played (bowing, fingering, etc.)
